; REQ: LANG-701 LANG-702 LANG-703 LANG-704
section .data
    msg db "Hello, world!", 10
    len equ $ - msg

section .text
    global _start

_start:
    mov rax, 1              ; sys_write
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel msg]
    mov rdx, len
    syscall
.loop:
    dec rcx
    jnz .loop
    xor edi, edi
    mov eax, 60
    syscall

# GNU syntax
    movq $0x1F, %rax
    addq %rbx, %rax
